findings.resolution: Fusion inputs and outputs are literal CANDIDATE and ANALYSIS_ONLY types with mayAuthorize=false, authorityEligible=false and maySatisfyReleaseEvidence=false. Confirmed source-node provenance never confirms semantic relevance.
A3 blocking gaps create UPSTREAM_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE and keep overall analysis incomplete; A4 reports its narrower fusion completeness separately and cannot launder an incomplete context pack.

Request, query, graph, ontology, profile, context, channel, policy and evaluation identities are validated against independent roots. Trusted replay recompiles and rejects paired content/digest mutation.
Every channel root is strictly reconstructed and checked against the fixed evaluation time, even when the channel returns zero candidates. Future, expired and forged roots fail closed.

Exact and confirmed-graph bundles are admitted ahead of proposal-only bundles using only protected-channel contributions and canonical ties. Semantic corroboration or flooding cannot change protected admission under a tight cap.

Evidence identifiers map to allowed context endpoints; logical claims are deduplicated before channel ranking; conflicting values remain an atomic set and any protected/conflict omission creates a blocking gap.

Retained as a truthful FOUNDATION boundary. Owner: reasoning.hybrid-candidate-fusion. Acceptance: exact, lexical, graph and in-process semantic adapters emit the governed receipt contract and a service consumer verifies A3 transitively before fusion.
